findings.claim: In fetch_error_details, error_ids are zipped with events.values() from nodestore get_multi(). That dict does not preserve input order: it dedupes ids, merges cached items after fetched ones, and omits missing entries. As a result, error IDs get paired with the wrong event data.

verifier.reason: In src/sentry/replays/endpoints/project_replay_summarize_breadcrumbs.py:107-118, fetch_error_details zips error_ids with events.values() from nodestore.backend.get_multi(node_ids). NodeStorage.get_multi deduplicates ids (src/sentry/nodestore/base.py:184) and merges cached entries after fetched ones via items.update(cache_items) (src/sentry/nodestore/base.py:204), while DjangoNodeStorage._get_bytes_multi omits missing entries (src/sentry/nodestore/django/backend.py:49), pairing ErrorEvent['id'] with mismatched event data (though generate_error_log_message at line 125 currently ignores id).

findings.claim: When the use-table-widget-visualization feature flag is enabled, TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with columns=[] and empty tableData. The actual results and loading state are ignored, so the table is always blank.

verifier.reason: In static/app/views/dashboards/widgetCard/chart.tsx:164-174, when organization.features includes 'use-table-widget-visualization', TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with hardcoded columns={[]} and empty tableData ({data: [], meta: {fields: {}, units: {}}}), ignoring both result and loading. In static/app/views/dashboards/widgets/tableWidget/tableWidgetVisualization.tsx:87-98, this passes empty columnOrder and data to GridEditable, so the table always renders empty with no columns or rows.

findings.claim: The age/timestamp mutual-exclusion validators in BrowserReportSerializer use the truthiness of self.initial_data.get(...). A value of 0 is therefore treated as absent, and age=0 combined with timestamp passes validation.

verifier.reason: src/sentry/issues/endpoints/browser_reporting_collector.py:52,58 check truthiness via self.initial_data.get("age") and self.initial_data.get("timestamp"), treating 0 as absent. As a result, age=0 combined with timestamp=0 passes full validation (while age=0 with a non-zero timestamp bypasses validate_timestamp, though validate_age still rejects it).

findings.claim: Both age and timestamp are required=False with only field-level validators, so a report with neither field is accepted. The docstrings say one of them must be present.

verifier.reason: In src/sentry/issues/endpoints/browser_reporting_collector.py:47-48, BrowserReportSerializer defines both age and timestamp with required=False and only implements field-level validate_timestamp (lines 50-54) and validate_age (lines 56-60), whose docstrings (lines 51, 57) require one to be present and the other absent. Because DRF skips field-level validators when optional fields are omitted and there is no object-level validate() method, a report with neither field passes validation at line 105.

findings.claim: The useGetTraceItemAttributeValues call defaults to page filters instead of using the provided projectIds prop.

verifier.reason: In static/app/views/insights/pages/transactionNameSearchBar.tsx:54-57, TransactionNameSearchBar calls useGetTraceItemAttributeValues without passing its projectIds prop (declared at line 29 and destructured at line 36). As a result, static/app/views/explore/hooks/useGetTraceItemAttributeValues.tsx:100 falls back to selection.projects from usePageFilters() instead of scoping autocomplete queries to the provided projectIds.
